sentence: This project studies how valley oak trees respond to drought, looking at gene expression and DNA methylation in seedlings.
This project tests ways to design RNA medicines so they keep working after chemical changes made to make them more stable and safe.
This project uses a technique that controls cells with light to grow cardiac organoids from human stem cells and study how heart cells mature.
This project studies how attacks made with AI can fool speaker and speech recognition and builds defenses to stop them.
This project tests a liquid/liquid extraction method to separate lithium isotopes in a pilot-scale production system.
This project builds compact light detectors from chiral hybrid perovskites that turn the color and circular polarization of light into electrical signals.
This project studies how small animals move through water so efficiently, using high-speed imaging and computer simulations of fluid flow.
This project runs a facility that operates seismic networks and instruments and shares data for studying earthquakes, volcanoes and the Earth's interior.
This project develops a 3D printing process that combines several materials to make smart devices that can change shape to fit individual patients.
This project builds a metal 3D printing machine that uses sensors to watch and control the printing process in real time.
This project studies how farming practices such as no-tillage and cover crops affect crop yield, soil carbon storage and greenhouse gases.
This project uses quantum computing to speed up how artificial intelligence learns to control complex systems.
This project holds a meeting where cybersecurity researchers share their work on protecting scientific infrastructure.
This project sets up a cybersecurity program focused on protecting critical infrastructure such as energy grids and telecommunications networks.
This project builds an ultrasound imaging technique that uses deep learning to see brain activity in fine detail, and tests it in mouse brains.
This project builds a handheld robotic instrument that attaches to a conventional endoscope, with software to model and control how it moves.
